title: 4521-INS-LOI-039-062-0003-GAR REV 0 Tube Bending Procedure
summary:
- The document is titled 'Tube Bending Procedure OIL TO SALT HEX'.
- It is owned by Abengoa and cannot be reproduced or distributed without permission.
- The procedure defines methods for bending U-tubes, including dimensions and machines used.
- Acceptance criteria, stress relieving heat treatment, and hydrostatic tests are outlined.
- Two types of tube bending machines are used: automatic and manual.
- Automatic machine for small radius bends with fixed tools and controllable angle.
- Manual machine for larger radius bends with adjustable radius and development.
- Acceptance criteria involve fitting tubes in carved wooden samples.
- Stress relieving heat treatment is done by induction method.
- Hydrostatic test must be conducted according to ASME VIII Div.2 and SA-556 codes.
- Additional requirements include 10% liquid penetrant inspection, cleaning of lubricants, and maximum out-of-roundness of 10%.
